name: Southeast Faerûn
title: Southwest Faerûn: Lands of Adventure
description: Southwest Faerûn is a region of ancient empires, lush jungles, and treacherous coastlines. It includes the merchant-ruled lands of Amn, the war-torn kingdom of Tethyr, and the exotic Chultan Peninsula.
wiki: Southwest Faerûn is dominated by several distinct sub-regions. The Lands of Intrigue (Amn, Tethyr, Calimshan) are known for their wealth and political maneuvering. Further south lies Chult, a primal wilderness filled with dinosaurs and abandoned cities of gold. The region is a hotspot for explorers and fortune-seekers.
